# Code of conduct

We follow the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/),
in issues, pull requests, reviews, chats and calls.

In short: be respectful, criticize the code and not the person, assume good intent, and help newer teammates.

To report unacceptable behavior, contact an owner of the **yapindo-frontend** organization privately.
Reports are kept confidential.
